composeFile.description: Compose file path relative to the Nx project.

dryRun.description: Preview the changes through Docker Compose.

services.description: Start only these services and their dependencies. By default, start all services.

build.description: Build images before starting the services.

detached.description: Start the services in the background.

exitCodeFrom.description: Wait for the Compose services and return the exit code of this service.

abortOnContainerExit.description: Stop the other services when any container exits.
